The '''Kamat Krote''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], [[Bosthirda/Legends|Bosthirda]], [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], and [[Jaguada/Legends|Jaguada]] in the [[Stygian Caldera]]. Originally forged by the ancient [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], the route was lost to history by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. However, the route's existence was theorized by researchers under the orders of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] in [[4999 BBY]], and the [[Sith exodus]] followed this route gradually over twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] to escape the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion|counterinvasion]] of the Sith Empire. The exodus eventually reached safety on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], and under Vitiate's rule [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|restored the Sith Empire]] there.<ref name="Revan" />
